title: Same name, other states: rows set aside from the federal download
question: Does the federal download for these organisations include other bodies that only share the name?
finding: Yes. Of 2,281 award rows the download kept, 33 ($4.9 million) belong to recipients in states where the City-paid organisation has no other rows, mostly small pandemic loans: Family Support Services (SC (4), MD (3), KY (2), AL (2), NJ (2), GA (1)); Fresh Approach (AZ (4), TX (1), FL (1)); Horizon Services, Inc (TX (3), GA (1), OK (1)); Each One Reach One Inc (TX (2), FL (2)). They are left out of every figure here, so the download's own total of $4.08 billion overstates what these organisations received.
how: Recipient state read from the recipient address on each row; rows in another state are set aside when the same organisation has California rows or its rows are spread over several states.
limits: A national organisation can have branches in several states; any such branch is set aside here too, so the kept figures are a floor.

sources.t: USAspending: prime awards for 83 City-paid organisations based outside San Francisco, award activity FY2019-FY2026 (retrieved 20 November 2026)
